[.walkthrough]
.Sign in as a user, then switch to an admin
. On the login page, open the *⋮* menu at the end of the toolbar and choose *Impersonate App User*. Type a username in the [.walkthrough-look]#panel#.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/01-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/01-open.jpg"]
. Click *Switch User*. The page reloads with you signed in as that user, without a password: the [.walkthrough-look]#menu# lists the views that a user may open.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/02-in.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/02-in.jpg"]
. Open the panel again: it lists the usernames you've used. Switch to an administrator, and the [.walkthrough-look]#menu# has the views for administrators too.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/03-switch.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/impersonate-users/03-switch.jpg"]
